name: 338-version-probe-command-not-run
note: #338: the probe agent dropped the final quote of the nested-quoting command it re-typed; the shell refused it, probe-run.cjs never ran and no record exists (empty line, verify says no-record). The run ends as the documented provision-failed with probeReason command-not-run, not unparseable-line.

args.brief: a probe command that never ran must be named command-not-run, not unparseable-line
